blinding.statement: Real-data outputs were inspected during pipeline development. Final tracer definitions, separation/redshift bins, nuisance model, production seed and independent closure seeds were fixed before the final closure tests. No result is described as a blinded measurement.

primary_observational_inference.estimator: full-sample five-tracer luminosity-rank conservative nuisance-projected DESI DR1 fit
primary_observational_inference.selection_rationale: This direct real-data analysis predates the later external mock-covariance closure. Retaining it as the headline result avoids selecting a primary coefficient after comparing EZmock and Abacus covariance estimates.
primary_observational_inference.preregistration_status: The analysis hierarchy is documented after closure and is not claimed as a formal preregistration.

ezmock_random_rank_placebo.reason_not_primary: Released EZmock catalogs used here do not provide the luminosity field required for the physical luminosity-ranked tracer construction.

abacus_physical_mock_calibration.reason_not_primary: The 25-mock ensemble is modest relative to the 18-dimensional vector and the inferred significance is covariance-estimator dependent: OAS gives -1.779 sigma while the raw-sample/Hartlap control gives -0.722 sigma. The layer is retained as a physical-mock validation, not as the headline likelihood.

provenance_guardrails: The full-sample luminosity-rank conservative DESI fit is the sole publication-facing headline observational coefficient.
Gfinder is a tracer-proxy robustness cross-check, not an alternative headline coefficient.
EZmock is a random-rank geometry/covariance/systematics placebo ensemble, not a luminosity-matched physical covariance.
Abacus is the physical luminosity-ranked high-fidelity mock layer, but its 25/18 mock-to-dimension ratio and OAS/Hartlap sensitivity keep it in a cross-check role.
The conservative nuisance-projected DESI result is the primary real-data inference; the minimal two-template fit is seed-sensitive and retained only as a diagnostic/control.
The Abacus amplitude sweep is a compressed-vector / forward-window linear-response validation, not an independent catalog-level signal injection before pair compression.
No real-data or mock result in this snapshot is a claimed neutrino-wake detection.
Exploratory shared-random EZmock outputs are excluded from production.
